newsitem.title: UK: Enterprise Oil shares reach new peak.
newsitem.headline: Enterprise Oil shares reach new peak.

text.p: Shares in Enterprise Oil Plc rose sharply for a third day with some traders saying there was speculation that the company could be target of a bid, perhaps from an Italian company interested in its interests there.

The stock was up 12-1/2p at 583-1/2 by 0950 GMT in active trade of 1.9 million shares. Earlier the stock reached a record 600p, 90p above its level at the end of August and 202p higher than at the end of last year.
"The stock was weak first thing then all the bid rumours started flying around," said the head of equity trading at one brokerage.
Possible bidders were said to include Italy's state controlled energy giant ENI SpA, possibly through its
Said another trader: "There is talk that an Italian company may be interested because of Enterprise's activities in Italy."
Yet others pointed out Enterprise was taking a group of analysts to visit its activities in southern Italy later this month and the stock may be rising on expectations of positive news from the trip.

Enterprise began its latest sharp rally last week after upbeat comments at a conference in the U.S. by group managing director Mike Pink on the level of recoverable reserves at its Norwegian Valhall oil field.
A spokeswoman for Enterprise said the company was aware of the rumours but had a policy of not commenting on market speculation.
